items.title: Third U.S. carrier arrives, stoking concerns about renewed conflicts with Iran
items.title_zh: 第三艘美国航母抵达，加剧了人们对与伊朗再次发生冲突的担忧
items.summary: Iran has ratcheted up threats against U.S. forces as a third American aircraft carrier arrived in the Gulf, stoking fears of a resumption of military tensions.
items.summary_zh: 随着第三艘美国航空母舰抵达海湾地区，伊朗加大了对美军的威胁，引发了人们对军事紧张局势再度升级的担忧。

items.title: Wondermind Investor Lawsuit Against Selena Gomez and Co-Founders Dismissed
items.title_zh: Wondermind 投资者对赛琳娜·戈麦斯及联合创始人的诉讼被驳回
items.summary: A federal lawsuit against Selena Gomez and fellow Wondermind co-founders Mandy Teefey and Daniella Pierson has been dismissed, the star’s litigator Mathew S. Rosengart confirmed Monday.
items.summary_zh: 明星的诉讼律师Mathew S. Rosengart周一确认，针对Selena Gomez以及Wondermind的共同创始人Mandy Teefey和Daniella Pierson的联邦诉讼已被驳回。

items.title: Elizabeth Debicki Says ‘Tenet’ Co-Star Robert Pattinson Will Be the ‘Perfect’ James Bond: ‘I’m So Thrilled’
items.title_zh: 伊丽莎白·德比齐表示，《信条》的合作演员罗伯特·帕丁森将是“完美的”詹姆斯·邦德：“我太兴奋了”
items.summary: Elizabeth Debicki is weighing in on her “Tenet” co-star Robert Pattinson becoming the next James Bond. “I’m so happy for Rob,” said Debicki at the Los Angeles premiere of “The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth.” When asked why Pattinson will…
items.summary_zh: 伊丽莎白·德比齐正在考虑让她的《信条》搭档罗伯特·帕丁森成为下一任詹姆斯·邦德。“我为罗伯特感到非常高兴，”德比基在《克里夫·布斯的更多奇遇》的洛杉矶首映式上说道。当被问及为什么帕丁森会……

items.title: Analysis: The Fed's chairman sees an AI revolution coming. Now he has to figure out what it means
items.title_zh: 分析：美联储主席认为人工智能革命即将到来。现在他必须弄清楚这意味着什么
items.summary: Kevin Warsh sees AI at a turning point. He faces tough questions on jobs and interest rates.
items.summary_zh: 凯文·沃什认为人工智能正处于一个转折点。他面临着有关就业和利率的棘手问题。

items.title: United Airlines resolves system outage that affected departing flights
items.title_zh: 美国联合航空公司解决了影响出港航班的系统故障
items.summary: The airline said there was no impact on flights in progress and there was no indication the outage was a cyberattack.
items.summary_zh: 该航空公司表示，正在进行的航班未受影响，也没有迹象表明此次中断是网络攻击所致。

items.title: Hacker behind 2022 GTA VI leaks pleads guilty
items.title_zh: 2022年《GTA VI》泄露事件背后的黑客认罪
items.summary: Arion Kurtaj, a member of the Lapsus$ cybercrime group who leaked 90 videos of Grand Theft Auto VI in 2022 and hacked other big companies, pleaded guilty on Monday, according to the UK's Crown Prosecution Service (CPS).
items.summary_zh: 据英国皇家检察署（CPS）消息，Lapsus$网络犯罪团伙成员Arion Kurtaj于周一认罪。该团伙于2022年泄露了90段《侠盗猎车手6》的视频，并黑进了其他多家大公司。

items.title: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months
items.title_zh: 网络安全AI初创公司Corma在约3个月内估值达到10亿美元
items.summary: Three months since introducing its product, AI cybersecurity startup Corba has raised a $125 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation led by NEA.
items.summary_zh: 自推出产品以来的三个月内，人工智能网络安全初创公司Corba已完成由NEA领投的1.25亿美元A轮融资，估值达10亿美元。

items.title: Cyber giant Infoblox confirms security incident after hackers access ‘company information’
items.title_zh: 网络巨头Infoblox确认发生安全事件，黑客已访问“公司信息”
items.summary: The cybersecurity and automation giant said it's working with outside investigators to understand the scale of the breach.
items.summary_zh: 这家网络安全和自动化巨头表示，正在与外部调查人员合作，以了解此次泄露的规模。

items.title: I spent months testing pillows to find six top picks for every kind of sleeper
items.title_zh: 我花了几个月的时间测试枕头，为每种睡姿选出了六款最佳枕头。
items.summary: If your pillows are flatter than a pancake, it’s time to upgrade. From foam and latex to classic down, there is one here that’s right for you Could these three pillows unseat my favorite?
items.summary_zh: 如果您的枕头比煎饼还扁，那就该换新了。从泡沫和乳胶到经典的羽绒，这里总有一款适合您。这三款枕头能取代我最喜欢的枕头吗？

items.title: Naming your feelings can be harder than you think. This simple tool can help
items.title_zh: 为自己的感受命名可能比您想象的要难。这个简单的工具可以帮到您
items.summary: About 10% of people have significant trouble identifying their emotions – which makes it harder to know what to do about them Naming emotions is a core skill that most people develop as children, and it might seem like second nature.
items.summary_zh: 大约10%的人在识别自己的情绪方面存在显著困难，这使得他们更难知道该如何应对这些情绪。识别情绪是一种核心技能，大多数人在童年时期就会习得，这看起来可能像是一种本能。
